summary.text: Steve Hohe is a retired U.S. Air Force veteran and former businessman running as the Libertarian Party candidate. He has previously run as a Libertarian for the U.S. House in 2020 and 2022 and for the Kansas House in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Lived in Kansas City, Missouri before joining the U.S. Air Force, where he served from 1980 to 1991, mainly in the Strategic Air Command and during Operations Desert Shield and Desert Storm, according to his Ballotpedia survey response.
Earned an associate degree from the Community College of the Air Force (1991) and a bachelor's degree from Husson College (1992).
Moved to Kansas after leaving the Air Force and, in his own words, lived in Shawnee for over 25 years; describes himself as a former owner of two businesses, married with two children.
Was a candidate in the general elections for Kansas's 3rd Congressional District in 2020 and 2022, both won by Sharice Davids, and for Kansas House District 18 in 2024, won by Cindy Neighbor.
